I created the contact Rosa Quispe, not linked to any third party. The saved card shows job position Bookkeeper, email r.quispe@example.invalid and professional phone 555-0203. The phone number was blank after the first save, so I opened the contact, entered it again and saved. I left every other field as it was.

I couldn't see the browser address bar, so I don't have the record's ID or URL. The contact's page is open in Dolibarr and it also appears in Third-parties → Contacts/Addresses → List.
